commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- README.md delivery.md tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py; git log -1 --format='%h %s'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py; git rev-parse HEAD'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path(p) for p in ('README.md', 'delivery.md', 'docs/task-completion.md', 'docs/work/investigation/repeated-completion.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    for target in re.findall(r'\\[["'^'"\\]]+\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
        assert (page.parent / target).exists(), (page, target)
        count += 1
source = Path('tasklist/tasks.py').read_text()
tests = Path('tests/test_tasks.py').read_text()
assert 'def finish_task(' in source
for name in ('test_complete_marks_done', 'test_repeat_completion_is_idempotent', 'test_missing_id_rejected'):
    assert f'def {name}(' in tests
print(f'Validated {count} local documentation links and referenced completion symbols.')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git diff -- delivery.md; cat docs/task-completion.md docs/work/investigation/repeated-completion.md'
